title: Growing up in Springfield, Ohio, ragtime and Ohio musicians
summary: Bushell gives his birthplace and uncertain birth year (1900 or 1902), recalls the happy musical atmosphere of Springfield and Columbus, ragtime, pianist Irene and Ted Lewis.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: (unintelligible) Monk. Originally I came out of Ohio, was born in Ohio -- Springfield, Ohio, to be exact. They have it stated that I was born in 1902, and in rummaging through some of the effects of my mother when she passed in '68, I found a book stating that I was born in 1900. So, give or take, it was either 1902 or 1900, anyhow, it was very close to the beginning of the 20th Century, in Springfield. As I recollect, there was a very happy atmosphere in Ohio in those days when I was a kid. Nothing but pleasure and a lot of good music, I remember distinctly. And as we grew up we began to hear some very good marching bands and it seems as though Springfield was sort of in tune with the progress of American popular music -- not only Springfield, but Columbus was also a
Oh, yes, Columbus, Ohio. And then it extended over into Indianapolis.

Yes, Indiana. Yes, because I remember distinctly a lady came to Springfield -- her first name was Irene. A very fine pianist -- this was about 1910 or 11 and since then I've heard that she became the wife of Teddy Wilson, who taught Teddy Wilson how to play piano. She came out of Indiana, out of Indianapolis. And it seems as though ragtime was just the major thing to have for your parties and the new tunes as they came out -- Springfield had them. As soon as New York turned them loose, then they came to Springfield and Columbus. So, I find that a lot of jazz musicians and classical musicians came out of Ohio. The great Ted Lewis came out of Circleville.
Oh, yes, he was born in Ohio.
Yes, yes. And there's another fine -- one of the first tenor players to record -- he came also out of Springfield, so --
